ck_race_roll_dims_ergaster_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_ergaster_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_crimson }
			40 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_auburn }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_raven }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_ergaster_has_shade_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
		}
	}
}

ck_race_inherit_dims_antecessor_effect = {

ck_race_inherit_dims_ergaster_effect = {
	# hair: copy from a parent of the ergaster people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes ck_ergaster_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes ck_ergaster_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father }
		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }
		}
	}
	random = {
		chance = 75
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_crimson } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_crimson }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_auburn } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_auburn }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_raven } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_raven }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_crimson } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_crimson }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_auburn } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_auburn }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_raven } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_raven }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_ergaster_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_crimson }
			40 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_auburn }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_raven }
		}
	}
	# shade: average of two parents of the ergaster people (odd sum: coin flip, 20 % drift), one parent: copy 75 %, else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum }
		change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl divide = 2 }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 1 local_var:ck_bl < 2 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 2 local_var:ck_bl < 3 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 3 local_var:ck_bl < 4 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 4 local_var:ck_bl < 5 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } } } }
		random = { chance = 20 random_list = { 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = -1 } } 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl < 1 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 5 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 1 }
		random = { chance = 75 set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum } }
	}
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 1 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 2 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 3 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 4 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 5 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_ergaster_has_shade_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
		}
	}
}

ck_race_inherit_dims_archon_effect = {
	# sigil: copy from a parent of the archon people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes ck_archon_has_sigil_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes ck_archon_has_sigil_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father }
		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }
		}
	}
	random = {
		chance = 75
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_saturn } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_saturn }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_jupiter } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_jupiter }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_mars } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_mars }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_sun } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_sun }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_venus } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_venus }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_mercury } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_mercury }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_moon } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_moon }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_saturn } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_saturn }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_jupiter } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_jupiter }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_mars } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_mars }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_sun } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_sun }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_venus } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_venus }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_mercury } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_mercury }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_sigil_moon } } add_character_flag = ck_sigil_moon }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_archon_has_sigil_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_sigil_saturn }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_sigil_jupiter }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_sigil_mars }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_sigil_sun }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_sigil_venus }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_sigil_mercury }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_sigil_moon }
		}
	}
	# hair: copy from a parent of the archon people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes ck_archon_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes ck_archon_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father }
		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }
		}
	}
	random = {
		chance = 75
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_white } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_white }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_silver } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_silver }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_raven } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_raven }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_white } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_white }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_silver } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_silver }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_raven } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_raven }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_archon_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			40 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_white }
			40 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_silver }
			20 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_raven }
		}
	}
	# shade: average of two parents of the archon people (odd sum: coin flip, 20 % drift), one parent: copy 75 %, else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum }
		change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl divide = 2 }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 1 local_var:ck_bl < 2 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 2 local_var:ck_bl < 3 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 3 local_var:ck_bl < 4 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 4 local_var:ck_bl < 5 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } } } }
		random = { chance = 20 random_list = { 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = -1 } } 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl < 1 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 5 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 1 }
		random = { chance = 75 set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum } }
	}
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 1 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 2 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 3 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 4 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 5 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_archon_has_shade_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
		}
	}
}

ck_race_inherit_dims_aeon_effect = {
	# stars: copy from a parent of the aeon people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes ck_aeon_has_stars_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes ck_aeon_has_stars_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }

		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }
		}
	}
	random = {
		chance = 75

			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }

			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_stars_b } } add_character_flag = ck_stars_b }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_stars_c } } add_character_flag = ck_stars_c }

			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_stars_b } } add_character_flag = ck_stars_b }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_stars_c } } add_character_flag = ck_stars_c }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_aeon_has_stars_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_stars_a }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_stars_b }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_stars_c }
		}
	}
	# eye: copy from a parent of the aeon people (75 %), else roll

		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes ck_aeon_has_eye_trigger = yes } }

		}

		chance = 75
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_eye_gold } } add_character_flag = ck_eye_gold }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_eye_violet } } add_character_flag = ck_eye_violet }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_eye_gold } } add_character_flag = ck_eye_gold }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_eye_violet } } add_character_flag = ck_eye_violet }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_aeon_has_eye_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			60 = { add_character_flag = ck_eye_gold }
			40 = { add_character_flag = ck_eye_violet }
		}
	}
	# hair: copy from a parent of the aeon people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes ck_aeon_has_hair_trigger = yes } }

		}

			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }

			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_silver } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_silver }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_white } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_white }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_palegold } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_palegold }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_silver } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_silver }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_white } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_white }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_aeon_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			45 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_palegold }
			35 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_silver }
			20 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_white }
		}
	}
	# shade: average of two parents of the aeon people (odd sum: coin flip, 20 % drift), one parent: copy 75 %, else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum value = 0 }

	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum }
		change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl divide = 2 }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 1 local_var:ck_bl < 2 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 2 local_var:ck_bl < 3 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 3 local_var:ck_bl < 4 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 4 local_var:ck_bl < 5 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } } } }
		random = { chance = 20 random_list = { 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = -1 } } 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl < 1 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 5 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 1 }
		random = { chance = 75 set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum } }
	}
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 1 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 2 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 3 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 4 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 5 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_aeon_has_shade_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {

			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
		}
	}
}

ck_race_inherit_dims_jotnar_effect = {
	# hair: copy from a parent of the jotnar people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }

		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_jotnar_trigger = yes ck_jotnar_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }

		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_jotnar_trigger = yes ck_jotnar_has_hair_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father }
		}

		}

			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }

			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_iceblond } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_iceblond }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_ginger } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_ginger }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_white } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_white }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_hair_iceblond } } add_character_flag = ck_hair_iceblond }

			35 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_white }
			45 = { add_character_flag = ck_hair_iceblond }

	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_jotnar_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_jotnar_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum }
		change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl divide = 2 }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 1 local_var:ck_bl < 2 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 2 local_var:ck_bl < 3 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 3 local_var:ck_bl < 4 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 4 local_var:ck_bl < 5 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } } } }
		random = { chance = 20 random_list = { 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = -1 } } 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl < 1 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 5 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 1 }
		random = { chance = 75 set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum } }
	}
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 1 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 2 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 3 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 4 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 5 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_jotnar_has_shade_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

ck_race_inherit_dims_mau_khet_effect = {
	# pattern: copy from a parent of the mau_khet people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes ck_mau_khet_has_pattern_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes ck_mau_khet_has_pattern_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father }
		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }
		}
	}
	random = {
		chance = 75
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_pattern_spotted } } add_character_flag = ck_pattern_spotted }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_pattern_ticked } } add_character_flag = ck_pattern_ticked }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_pattern_solid } } add_character_flag = ck_pattern_solid }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_pattern_spotted } } add_character_flag = ck_pattern_spotted }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_pattern_ticked } } add_character_flag = ck_pattern_ticked }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_pattern_solid } } add_character_flag = ck_pattern_solid }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_mau_khet_has_pattern_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			70 = { add_character_flag = ck_pattern_spotted }
			20 = { add_character_flag = ck_pattern_ticked }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_pattern_solid }
		}
	}
	# coat: copy from a parent of the mau_khet people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes ck_mau_khet_has_coat_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes ck_mau_khet_has_coat_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father }
		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }
		}
	}
	random = {
		chance = 75
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_coat_silver } } add_character_flag = ck_coat_silver }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_coat_bronze } } add_character_flag = ck_coat_bronze }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_coat_smoke } } add_character_flag = ck_coat_smoke }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_coat_silver } } add_character_flag = ck_coat_silver }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_coat_bronze } } add_character_flag = ck_coat_bronze }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_coat_smoke } } add_character_flag = ck_coat_smoke }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_mau_khet_has_coat_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			40 = { add_character_flag = ck_coat_silver }
			40 = { add_character_flag = ck_coat_bronze }
			20 = { add_character_flag = ck_coat_smoke }
		}
	}
	# eye: copy from a parent of the mau_khet people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes ck_mau_khet_has_eye_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes ck_mau_khet_has_eye_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father }
		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }
		}
	}
	random = {
		chance = 75
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_eye_green } } add_character_flag = ck_eye_green }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_eye_amber } } add_character_flag = ck_eye_amber }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_eye_green } } add_character_flag = ck_eye_green }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_eye_amber } } add_character_flag = ck_eye_amber }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_mau_khet_has_eye_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			70 = { add_character_flag = ck_eye_green }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_eye_amber }
		}
	}
	# shade: average of two parents of the mau_khet people (odd sum: coin flip, 20 % drift), one parent: copy 75 %, else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum }
		change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl divide = 2 }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 1 local_var:ck_bl < 2 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 2 local_var:ck_bl < 3 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 3 local_var:ck_bl < 4 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 4 local_var:ck_bl < 5 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } } } }
		random = { chance = 20 random_list = { 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = -1 } } 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl < 1 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 5 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 1 }
		random = { chance = 75 set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum } }
	}
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 1 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 2 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 3 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 4 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 5 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_mau_khet_has_shade_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
		}
	}
}

	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum }
		change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl divide = 2 }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 1 local_var:ck_bl < 2 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 2 local_var:ck_bl < 3 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 3 local_var:ck_bl < 4 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 4 local_var:ck_bl < 5 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } } } }
		random = { chance = 20 random_list = { 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = -1 } } 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl < 1 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 5 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 1 }
		random = { chance = 75 set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum } }
	}
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 1 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 2 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 3 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 4 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 5 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_torquas_has_shade_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
		}
	}
}

ck_race_inherit_dims_phaeter_effect = {
	# bolt: copy from a parent of the phaeter people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_phaeter_trigger = yes ck_phaeter_has_bolt_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_phaeter_trigger = yes ck_phaeter_has_bolt_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father }
		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }
		}
	}
	random = {
		chance = 75
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_bolt_a } } add_character_flag = ck_bolt_a }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_bolt_b } } add_character_flag = ck_bolt_b }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_bolt_c } } add_character_flag = ck_bolt_c }
		}

			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_bolt_b }

			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_eye_storm } } add_character_flag = ck_eye_storm }

		}

	if = {

			60 = { add_character_flag = ck_eye_sky }
			40 = { add_character_flag = ck_eye_storm }
		}
	}
	# hair: copy from a parent of the phaeter people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {

ck_race_inherit_dims_auroran_effect = {

	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_auroran_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_auroran_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_auroran_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_auroran_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_auroran_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_auroran_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum }
		change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl divide = 2 }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 1 local_var:ck_bl < 2 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 2 local_var:ck_bl < 3 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 3 local_var:ck_bl < 4 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 4 local_var:ck_bl < 5 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } } } }
		random = { chance = 20 random_list = { 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = -1 } } 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl < 1 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 5 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 1 }
		random = { chance = 75 set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum } }
	}
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 1 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 2 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 3 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 4 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 5 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_auroran_has_shade_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
		}
	}
}

ck_race_inherit_dims_tauceti_effect = {
	# caste: copy from a parent of the tauceti people (75 %), else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:none }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes ck_tauceti_has_caste_trigger = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:mother }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes ck_tauceti_has_caste_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:none }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father }
		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_src value = flag:father } }
		}
	}
	random = {
		chance = 75
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:mother }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_caste_sunrise } } add_character_flag = ck_caste_sunrise }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_caste_eye } } add_character_flag = ck_caste_eye }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_caste_helix } } add_character_flag = ck_caste_helix }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_src = flag:father }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_caste_sunrise } } add_character_flag = ck_caste_sunrise }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_caste_eye } } add_character_flag = ck_caste_eye }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_caste_helix } } add_character_flag = ck_caste_helix }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_tauceti_has_caste_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_caste_sunrise }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_caste_eye }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_caste_helix }
		}
	}
	# shade: average of two parents of the tauceti people (odd sum: coin flip, 20 % drift), one parent: copy 75 %, else roll
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 1 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 2 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 3 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 4 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes has_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_sum add = 5 } change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl_n add = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum }
		change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl divide = 2 }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 1 local_var:ck_bl < 2 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 2 local_var:ck_bl < 3 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 2 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 3 local_var:ck_bl < 4 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 3 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 4 local_var:ck_bl < 5 } random_list = { 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 4 } } 50 = { set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } } } }
		random = { chance = 20 random_list = { 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = -1 } } 50 = { change_local_variable = { name = ck_bl add = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl < 1 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl > 5 } set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:ck_bl_n = 1 }
		random = { chance = 75 set_local_variable = { name = ck_bl value = local_var:ck_bl_sum } }
	}
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 1 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 2 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 3 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 4 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:ck_bl = 5 } add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { ck_tauceti_has_shade_trigger = yes } }
		random_list = {
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s1 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s2 }
			30 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s3 }
			25 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s4 }
			10 = { add_character_flag = ck_shade_s5 }
		}
	}
}

# Stamp a character that has no birth race yet from its culture. Every character gets ck_race_set once.
ck_race_stamp_from_culture_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_race_set } }
		add_character_flag = ck_race_set
		if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_antecessor_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_antecessor
			ck_race_roll_dims_antecessor_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_ergaster_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_ergaster
			ck_race_roll_dims_ergaster_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_archon_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_archon
			ck_race_roll_dims_archon_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_aeon_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_aeon
			ck_race_roll_dims_aeon_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_neanderthal_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_neanderthal
			ck_race_roll_dims_neanderthal_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_jotnar_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_jotnar
			ck_race_roll_dims_jotnar_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_cathrian_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_cathrian
			ck_race_roll_dims_cathrian_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_mau_khet
			ck_race_roll_dims_mau_khet_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_thark_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_thark
			ck_race_roll_dims_thark_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_torquas_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_torquas
			ck_race_roll_dims_torquas_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_phaeter_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_phaeter
			ck_race_roll_dims_phaeter_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_auroran_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_auroran
			ck_race_roll_dims_auroran_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ck_culture_is_tauceti_trigger = yes }
			add_character_flag = ck_race_tauceti
			ck_race_roll_dims_tauceti_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

ck_race_fill_dims_effect = {
	if = { limit = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_ergaster_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_archon_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_aeon_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_jotnar_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_jotnar_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_cathrian_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_cathrian_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_mau_khet_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_mau_khet_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_thark_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_thark_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_torquas_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_torquas_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_phaeter_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_phaeter_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_auroran_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_auroran_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { ck_is_tauceti_trigger = yes } ck_race_roll_dims_tauceti_effect = yes }
}

# Birth (on_birth_child, root = the child; scope:mother, scope:real_father). Dose per people: a full parent
# gives 2, a half-blood 1. The people with the highest dose wins (ties: coin flip). Dose 3-4 = full,
# 2 = half-blood, 1 = 50 % half-blood, 0 = human. Parents not stamped yet are stamped from their culture first.
ck_race_stamp_birth_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_race_set } }
		add_character_flag = ck_race_set
		if = { limit = { exists = scope:mother } scope:mother = { ck_race_stamp_from_culture_effect = yes } }
		if = { limit = { exists = scope:real_father } scope:real_father = { ck_race_stamp_from_culture_effect = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_best value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:none }
		# antecessor
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_dose value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_antecessor_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_antecessor_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > local_var:ck_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best value = local_var:ck_dose }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:antecessor }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > 0 local_var:ck_dose = local_var:ck_best }
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:antecessor } }
		}
		# ergaster
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_dose value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_ergaster_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > local_var:ck_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best value = local_var:ck_dose }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:ergaster }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > 0 local_var:ck_dose = local_var:ck_best }
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:ergaster } }
		}
		# archon
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_dose value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_archon_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > local_var:ck_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best value = local_var:ck_dose }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:archon }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > 0 local_var:ck_dose = local_var:ck_best }
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:archon } }
		}
		# aeon
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_dose value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_aeon_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > local_var:ck_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best value = local_var:ck_dose }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:aeon }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > 0 local_var:ck_dose = local_var:ck_best }
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:aeon } }
		}
		# neanderthal
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_dose value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_neanderthal_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:mother = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:real_father scope:real_father = { ck_is_neanderthal_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }
			if = { limit = { scope:real_father = { has_character_flag = ck_race_half } } change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = -1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > local_var:ck_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best value = local_var:ck_dose }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:neanderthal }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > 0 local_var:ck_dose = local_var:ck_best }
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:neanderthal } }
		}
		# jotnar
		set_local_variable = { name = ck_dose value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:mother scope:mother = { ck_is_jotnar_trigger = yes } }
			change_local_variable = { name = ck_dose add = 2 }

			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best value = local_var:ck_dose }
			set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:jotnar }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:ck_dose > 0 local_var:ck_dose = local_var:ck_best }
			random = { chance = 50 set_local_variable = { name = ck_best_people value = flag:jotnar } }
		}
